content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently overestimate prices in early cycles and underperform in late cycles.", "Sentiment peaks correlate with price surges, especially when sentiment is positive and exceeds 0.67.", "Model forecasts show mean-reversion bias, particularly when true outcomes deviate significantly from forecasted trends.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment aligns with historical price momentum, especially in downward trends.", "Models exhibit lag in capturing sentiment shifts, often missing early warning signals before price reversals.", "High sentiment volatility (>0.67) precedes sharp price corrections, suggesting model overconfidence in trending periods.", "Forecast bias is strongest in early 30-day windows, where models overestimate upward momentum.", "Sentiment-driven corrections are more pronounced when forecasted prices exceed true outcomes by >5%."] }
